dataset.name: MNIST handwritten digits
dataset.description: Real handwritten digit images from MNIST, normalized to 8x8 grayscale pixels for this demo.

preprocessing.name: CropSquareResize8 + StandardScaler
preprocessing.feature_transform: denoise at 50% of max ink, keep largest component, crop foreground, resize to square, area-average resize to 8x8, scale intensity to 0..16

augmentation.applied_to: disabled for MNIST; the source already contains real handwritten training images
